scientific_integrity: All graph, chain, and character calculations are exact finite computations reproduced by the accompanying dependency-free verifier. The proof of characteristic-zero boundary ranks uses chain-identity upper bounds as well as modular ranks; no unsupported inference from modular homology alone. No claims of independent verification or publication priority are made.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the 5-regular Clebsch open-neighborhood complex and its rational homology representation. It does not compute integral homology lattices or torsion of topological quotients, or prove equivariant homotopy equivalence. Unindexed equivalent work remains possible; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Three irreducible affine homology modules in the Clebsch neighborhood complex
